identification: Boxed Parker Sonnet fountain pen with a chevron (herringbone) engraved pattern on cap and barrel, gold-tone clip, cap band and grip section, rhodium-silver nib with engraved scroll, modern grey Sonnet box ('Sonnet, a timeless symbol of elegance... Ciselé pattern') with a Quink 5-pack. Google check: chevron/'Mediterranean wind' pattern with gold trim and gold grip is the Sonnet Premium Silver Mistral GT (sterling silver 925, 18k rhodium-plated nib), not the lattice-pattern Sonnet Sterling Cisele. Both are sterling; the plated/steel Sonnet has plain or lacquer finishes. Photos 1-2 viewed, zoomed on cap, band, clip and nib.
